answer: Ephemeral Reputation Windows: each identity’s score decays on a fixed half-life, so a clone must sustain real activity or lose standing before it pays back. A new identity starts on a low terrace and earns trust only through verified interactions. Every fresh clone therefore pays onboarding work, lost time, and floating zephyr of attention while its payoff stays blocked. Operators cap total active identities per orchard of shared network evidence, making each additional clone strictly negative-EV.
